# Advocates for Indigenous California Language Survival (AICLS)

> > A Native-led organization dedicated to the revitalization, preservation, and survival of indigenous California languages through community-centered programs and archival initiatives.

AICLS is a Native-run organization that implements language revitalization programs across California, focusing on connecting language learners with speakers through apprenticeship models and community research partnerships. The organization operates multiple flagship initiatives including the Master Apprentice Language Learning Program and the Breath of Life Archival Institute.

## Key Topics

- Indigenous language revitalization
- California Native languages
- Master Apprentice Program
- Breath of Life Archival Institute
- Language preservation
- Community-based learning
- Language apprenticeship
- Archival research
- Native-led organization
- Linguistic partnership
- Community programs
- Language is Life Gathering
- Seeds of Language Mini-Grant

## Core Organization

- [AICLS Homepage](https://www.aicls.org): Main website for Advocates for Indigenous California Language Survival, a Native-run and led organization devoted to implementing and supporting the revitalization of indigenous California languages
